description: OpenThoughts3-1.2M is an open-source dataset for training reasoning models, containing 1.2 million examples across math, code, and science domains (850,000 math, 250,000 code, and 100,000 science datapoints).
name: OpenThoughts3-1.2M
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Questions were sourced from various datasets, filtered by difficulty or response length using LLMs, and then answered 16 times by QwQ-32B. Exact deduplication was used for math and science, and no deduplication for code. No answer filtering was performed.
rai:dataCollection: Questions were sourced from 27 code, 21 math, and 14 science datasets. They were filtered using LLMs (difficulty-based for code, response length for math/science). QwQ-32B generated 16 answers per question.
rai:dataCollectionRawData: Raw data consists of questions from existing datasets like StackExchange, OpenCodeReasoning, NuminaMath, and AutoMathText.
rai:dataLimitations: Distilled reasoning models trained on this data still suffer from generalization deficits, as evident from strong performance fluctuations across natural problem and solution structure preserving variations.
rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Exact deduplication was applied to math and science questions. Code questions were not deduplicated.
rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Decontamination was performed against evaluation sets using Indel similarity (75% threshold) and N-gram-based similarity (N=13). Contaminated samples were discarded.
rai:dataUseCases: Training reasoning models via supervised fine-tuning (SFT).
rai:machineAnnotationTools: QwQ-32B (teacher model for generating answers), GPT-4o-mini (for difficulty filtering and question generation), GPT-4.1-mini (for response length filtering).
